sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Clarisant was an Arthurian heroine. She was the sister of the knight Gawain of the Round Table. She was the daughter of Morgause, the half sister of King Arthur, and of the king of the far northern island of Orkney. She lived in an enchanted castle with her lover, the king Guireomelant.

okr.objective: Clarisant is a knight's sister who dwells in an enchanted castle with her lover.
